name: EditableText
description: An interactive text component that can be edited in-place, transforming between text display and input field modes based on user interaction.
usage: Use for in-place editing of titles, labels, and short text content.

value is the saved text: controlled with value, uncontrolled with defaultValue. onChange(value) and onSave(value) both fire when an edit is saved; the draft while typing stays inside (the commit is the change).

Start editing by double-click, by Enter, Space or F2 when it has focus (it is a Tab stop at rest), or by clicking the optional pencil icon (showEditIcon). Leaving the field (blur) neither saves nor cancels: the draft stays open until Enter/Save or Escape/Cancel.
Edit mode includes a text input with save (check) and cancel (X) buttons.
Pressing Enter in the input field saves the changes, Escape cancels them; focus then goes back to the text.
Style the component with `className` and the input with `inputClassName`.
Use the `disabled` prop to prevent editing.
No error, touched or helperText: no use needs one yet (add them when one does). No size: it takes the font of its surroundings.
design: The component maintains the same text styling when transitioning between display and edit modes.
Input field width dynamically adjusts to match the text content length.
Edit icon (pencil) only appears on hover when `showEditIcon` is true, following progressive disclosure patterns.
Action buttons use semantic colors: success (green) for save, error (red) for cancel.
The component visually indicates its disabled state with reduced opacity.
Edit mode uses a slightly different background color to indicate the mode change.
At rest it shows a keyboard ring (focus-visible:ring-2 --color-border-focus, offset) and the pencil icon shows while the root has keyboard focus too.
accessibility: At rest the root is role=button, named by its text and ', edit' (it reads 'Sage, edit, button'), a Tab stop, and takes the ref, id and every unnamed prop except aria-label (data-*, onKeyDown…); Enter, Space or F2 starts editing, as does a screen reader's click. While editing it has no role. The pencil is a mouse target only: tabIndex -1 and aria-hidden, since a button can't hold another.
The input is named by the app's aria-label, or 'Edit text'; its id is `${id}-input`.
The save and cancel buttons are named 'Save' and 'Cancel'.
Focus moves into the input when editing starts and back to the root when it ends.
Escape in the input is claimed (preventDefault), so a dialog around it stays open.
An Enter that ends an IME composition (isComposing, or keyCode 229) does not save.
Disabled: no Tab stop, aria-disabled, no editing by any route.

props.name: id
props.description: The root's id; generated with useId() when left out. The input gets `${id}-input`

props.name: value
props.description: The saved text (controlled). Leave out for uncontrolled

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The text at first, when value is left out

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new text when an edit is saved (value-first; fires with onSave)

props.name: onSave
props.description: The commit: called with the new text when an edit is saved

props.name: showEditIcon
props.description: Show the pencil button (on hover or keyboard focus)

props.name: className
props.description: Merged with cn on the root; the app's class wins

props.name: inputClassName
props.description: Additional class for the input element

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown when the value is empty, and in the input

props.name: disabled
props.description: No editing; no Tab stop; aria-disabled

props.name: ref
props.description: The focusable root (no native field at rest)

props.name: ...rest
props.description: Every other prop goes to the root (aria-label names the field instead). The app's onKeyDown and onClick run first; preventDefault there skips ours
